title: Nervous system and special senses
stage: College neuroscience and cognitive science degree
audience: a college student in a neuroscience, cognitive science, psychology or biology degree program, or an adult studying the same material on their own
purpose: Integrate neuroanatomy, the cerebral circulation and neurophysiology with stroke, seizures, headache, head injury and raised pressure, movement and demyelinating disorders, neuromuscular disease, infections and tumors, dementia and delirium, and the eye and ear.

weeks.1: Neuroanatomy and the blood supply of the brain
weeks.6: Head injury and raised intracranial pressure
weeks.9: Infections and tumors of the nervous system

blocks.deliverable: Map stroke syndromes to arterial territories.
Outline acute stroke assessment and time windows.
Week 7 midterm; compare upper and lower motor neuron signs.
Interpret cerebrospinal fluid results in meningitis.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Lesion localization: localize ten supplied neurological presentations and choose the imaging and first treatment for each.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
